request_user:
Fact: integration_means
What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Usable via Hugging Face transformers (v4.51.0 or later) with AutoProcessor and Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, using processor.apply_chat_template for chat-format messages (text and image content) and model.generate; flex_attention, bfloat16. On-the-fly int4 quantization code is provided to fit Scout on a single H100 GPU.
quotes: Please, make sure you have transformers v4.51.0 installed, or upgrade using pip install -U transformers.
The Llama 4 Scout model is released as BF16 weights, but can fit within a single H100 GPU with on-the-fly int4 quantization
